role: Principal-led from first sketch to handover
quote: A structure is decided in its first three weeks. Everything after that is either carrying that decision or paying for it.
bio: Meridian Construction has been run by its engineers since 2003. A principal owns every commission from the first scheme to the day the operator takes the keys, reviews the analysis behind it, and is the person you speak to when something on site does not match the drawing. That is the whole management structure, and it is why a project here is never handed to someone who was not in the room when it was designed.
